We just launched the training of harness adapters? What is it exactly?

The goal: build openly and safely efficient + more accurate LoRA adapters for three coding harnesses: hermes, pi and opencode using RL and open environments!

We detail how the RL envs have been created, directly from opensource agentic trajectories, as well as how we plugged `safeagents` to automatically scan and mitigate for potential reward hacking during training. 

All relevant links in comments section!
